evidence.author: KarelTvrdik
evidence.used: what survives of the castle: a grassy earth mound cut by a path, with a low line of exposed rubble stone in its face, loose broken stone heaps at the left foot, and beech woodland all round; no standing tower or walls are visible
ruined 14th-century hradek in woodland (the brief's wall and tower stump are not seen in the photo, so only low rubble walls are modelled)

review.gaps: Trunks now crowned with dark bark and mound is ragged soil with grass caps, grey rubble line and left-foot heaps; crowns are smooth low-poly domes, understorey and roots only suggested.
